title: Number of Single Divisor Triplets
description: Find the number of triplets (i, j, k) such that 0 <= i < j < k < n and exactly one of the elements divides the sum of the other two.
pseudocode:
1. count = 0
2. for i = 0 to n-3
3.   for j = i+1 to n-2
4.     for k = j+1 to n-1
5.       sum = arr[i] + arr[j] + arr[k]
6.       divisors = (sum%arr[i]==0) + (sum%arr[j]==0) + (sum%arr[k]==0)
7.       if divisors == 1: count++

steps.note: Divisors count is 2, not 1. Count remains 0
